correctness.rationale: Conditioned on each noninduced planted copy, its motif vertices have distributions d_v+Bin(N-d_v,p), every other vertex has Bin(N,p), with independent unforced edges. This proves the exact mixed-moment ratio. Nonnegative inverse powers yield the unique probability root and its sign, rising falling factorials the degree-index crossing, and a uniform product expansion the sparse/dense asymptotics. verify.py passed 159 exact finite-case groups and 16 further root checks. Finite checks corroborate, not prove, the analytic identities.
